resolvedFindings.finding: Real Better Auth update/reveal rejected because the JWT has no default workspace
resolvedFindings.resolution: Derive the workspace from the authorized vault row.

resolvedFindings.finding: Admin could replace owner_only with owner_admin and then reveal
resolvedFindings.resolution: Existing owner_only ACL or stored-value changes now require authenticated Owner; unchanged metadata remains editable.

results.name: Owner and Admin encrypted create, metadata redaction and default Admin reveal grant
Encrypted rotation and metadata updates derive scope from the bound row
Owner-only record restricts Admin reveal while Owner remains authorized
Admin cannot weaken owner-only ACL or replace its stored value; unchanged metadata remains editable
Authenticated Owner can rotate owner-only value and update its access policy
Forged actingUserId cannot impersonate another principal during create/update/reveal
Foreign workspace cannot create against or mutate/reveal guessed vault records
Lower roles and disabled/invited/anonymous principals cannot create/update/reveal/delete
Own fixture records delete successfully without touching concurrent browser fixtures

limitations: Synthetic values only; no production credentials or external secret systems used.
Public metadata redaction and native encrypt/decrypt/rotate handlers exercised; raw ciphertext and encryption keys never exported.
Clerk principal binding is qualified separately by the native authorization oracle.
Browser viewport, role controls and reload behavior are qualified separately.
